goals.title: 100% of OAuth refresh tokens stay alive
goals.description: Daily pings keep Testing-mode Google refresh_tokens from expiring after 7 idle days. Verified emitted key.
directives: Ping every registered OAuth file daily
Alert on first failure - day 7 is too late

goals.title: Zero failed OAuth pings
goals.description: A failed ping means a token is on the 7-day expiry clock. Verified emitted key.
directives: On failure, name the file and the interactive re-auth command in the alert

goals.title: Every Google OAuth file in use is enrolled
goals.description: oauth_files_watched should equal the number of OAuth credential files agents actually use. Verified emitted key.
directives: When a new agent gains a Google integration, register its OAuth file here in the same change
